committee: KCA1; ordered Ed25519 keys, Keccak addresses and positive u64 voting power; unique key/address/holder; total power <= u64::MAX / 3
decision: KCD1; contiguous global consensus height; authenticated predecessor, historical committee and KVD1 descriptor
certificate: codec 1; canonical protobuf commit certificate; distinct committee signers; Ed25519 precommit signatures; strictly greater than two thirds of total power; no vote extensions
value: KVD1; chain, era, protocol and codec bound to exact ordered input bytes
application: kontor/coordinator/v1; deterministic certified closure before authorizing the next consensus height
activation: after Bitcoin H and its lifecycle; atomic migration; subsequent Batch(H) and H+1 use the successor
upgrade_control: codec 1; explicit committee authorization; reversible canonical effects; invalidated approvals require fresh authorization
history: retain authenticated decisions and historical committees across application rollback; confirmation does not reexecute prior canonical batches
